note: SENSITIVITY VARIANT of configs/data/week05_huy.json: only signal.refractory_s changed 0.25 -> 0.4 (v1 value), to show the R comparison under both settings. Not a second proposal.

sources.refractory_s: 0.25 s (week04 used 0.4 s) so that HR up to 240 bpm is not cut by the refractory period; engineering choice, no source. It applies to ECG R AND PPG peaks: a PPG diastolic wave can then give false feet (docs/protocol/week05_fiducials_pat_validity.md section 7); a separate PPG value is pending Huy's decision.
sources.pat_validity.min_ms/max_ms: Same 80-400 ms window as features-sqi-v1 pairing, but in pat_beats it is a label, not a pairing gate (pair_between_r pairs within the R-R interval, then out-of-range beats are labelled). No source for these bounds (chua co nguon). Context only: Mukkamala 2015 (10.1109/TBME.2015.2441951, docs/literature/week_01_literature_matrix.md #1) reports finger PAT at rest about 180-260 ms; wrist PAT is not given there.
sources.pat_validity.mad_k: MAD outlier rule: Leys et al. 2013 (10.1016/j.jesp.2013.03.013), metadata verified, full text not read; k = 3 is an engineering choice (chua co nguon for the value).
sources.pat_validity.mad_floor_ms: Absolute floor so that a near-constant PAT does not turn sample quantization (8 ms at 125 Hz) into outliers; found by a SYNTHETIC test on 2026-10-21; engineering choice, no source.
sources.agreement.tolerance_s: Matching windows for manual-vs-automatic comparison; no source (chua co nguon). Report results at the chosen tolerance only, decided before marking.
sources.r_energy_window_s: Moving-average width for the derivative-energy envelope; engineering choice, no source.
